CommunityApplications.Profile:
Brave Origin in Docker, with an Unraid template for remote browser access over HTTPS. Keep bookmarks, settings, extensions, and downloads in a persistent appdata folder. Includes password protection, copy and paste, audio, and automatic browser updates.
See the [setup instructions](https://github.com/shoyrock/Brave-Origin#readme) for installation help. Report problems or request features through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/shoyrock/Brave-Origin/issues).
